description_en: Schedules an idle cloud application service instance for the requesting client (ClientId) and starts the service. If the requesting client (ClientId) sends another start request after a successful start and the associated session is in the SessionStartSuspended state, the session is restarted. If the session is in any other state, the session information is returned directly
description_zh:
为请求端（ClientId）调度一个空闲云应用服务实例，并完成服务启动。
如果请求端（ClientId）启动请求发起成功后重复发起启动请求，若已关联会话处于启动暂停（SessionStartSuspended）状态，则重启会话；若会话为其他状态，则直接返回会话信息
kebab_example: aliyun vs start-rendering-session --project-id project-422bc38dfgh5eb44149f135ef76304f63b --client-id 04c30850-1d91-4da1-b811-66d0ee94af7d --app-id cap-b06b26edfhytbn_b94a75ae1a79efc90eb --client-params ClientIp=106.11.43.1 --patch-id patch-03fa76e8e13a49b63456b063dgh309b4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartRenderingSession

fields.help_en: Client IP address. This IP address is used by default for scheduling instances based on proximity
fields.help_zh: 终端客户Ip，将默认用于位置就近实例调度
fields.name: client_ip

parameters.help_en:
Cloud application patch ID.

1. By default, start the stable version of the AppId (if no stable patch version is set, the original version is used).

2. If you enter "origin", start the original version
parameters.help_zh:
云应用补丁包ID。
1. 默认启动AppId稳定版本（未设置稳定Patch版本时，默认为原始版本）
2. 输入origin时，启动原始版本
parameters.name: patch_id
